item.title: Ask HN: Will programmers write more efficient code during the memory shortage?
item.description:
📝 > use of more advanced algorithms and data structures that use less memory. At least at work there is a push to decrease memory usage but the way I've seen it playing out is not using some O(N) data structure instead of O(N lg(N)) per-say but instead replacing `int[]` with `byte[]` or in-lining some fields to remove some indirection costs. > use of more advanced algorithms and data structures that use less memory.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48604232
